candidate.answerReason: Because 3-x = -(x-3), the equation becomes x/(x-3) = 2 + 1/(x-3). For x ≠ 3, clearing the denominator gives x = 2(x-3)+1, so x = 5, which is allowed.

methods.label: Match the denominator signs and solve
methods.explanation: On the right-hand side, \(-\frac{1}{3-x}=\frac{1}{x-3}\). Multiplying both sides by \(x-3\) gives \(x=2(x-3)+1\), so \(x=5\). Checking gives \(x-3\ne0\), so \(x=5\).
